result.instructions: Tools for RentMy, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which rental products in the Camping category are available this weekend?"; "What would a 3-day rental of product 159775 cost from 2026-12-01 09:00 to 2026-12-04 09:00?"; "Add two units of this item to a new cart for next Friday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes RentMy data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rentmy_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rentmy_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rentmy_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rentmy_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rentmy_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the store's product categories, with first and second level child categories and their UUIDs. RentMy: GET /categories.

tools.name: rentmy_list_child_categories
tools.title: List child categories
tools.description: List the child categories under one category UUID. RentMy: GET /get/child-categories/{category_uuid}.

tools.name: rentmy_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the store's products with pagination, optionally filtered by price range or purchase type. Needs the store location (from login). RentMy: POST /products/online.

sort_by.description: Sort field, as RentMy names it.

sort_dir.description: Sort direction, as RentMy names it (the spec example is DSC).

purchase_type.description: Purchase type filter, as RentMy names it (rent, sale, ...).

all.description: Include all products, as RentMy's all flag.

tools.name: rentmy_search_products
tools.title: Search products
tools.description: Search the store's products by text. Needs the store location (from login). RentMy: POST /search/products.

search.description: Text to search for (product name or keyword).

tools.name: rentmy_list_products_in_category
tools.title: List products in a category
tools.description: List the products in one category, with pagination and optional filters. RentMy: POST /category/products/{category_uuid}.

price_min.description: Lowest price to include (whole number, per the spec).

price_max.description: Highest price to include (whole number, per the spec).

tools.name: rentmy_list_featured_products
tools.title: List featured products
tools.description: List the products the store features on its front page. RentMy: GET /products/featured.

tools.name: rentmy_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Get one product's full details by its product UID. RentMy: GET /products/{product_uid}.

product_uid.description: Product UID from a product list or search.

tools.name: rentmy_get_product_variant
tools.title: Get product variant
tools.description: Get one product variant's details by its variant ID. RentMy: GET /products/view/variant-product/{variant_id}.

tools.name: rentmy_list_product_addons
tools.title: List product add-ons
tools.description: List the add-on products for one product. Needs the store location (from login). RentMy: GET /products/{product_id}/addons.

required.description: Only required add-ons, as RentMy's required flag.

tools.name: rentmy_get_price
tools.title: Get rental price
tools.description: Price one rental for given dates and quantity, without changing the cart. Needs the store location (from login). RentMy: POST /get-price-value.

rental_type.description: Rental type, as RentMy names it (the spec example is rent).

price_id.description: Price rule ID, when a product has several.

rental_duration.description: Rental duration, as RentMy counts it.

tools.name: rentmy_check_package_availability
tools.title: Check package availability
tools.description: Check whether a package product is available for given dates. Needs the store location (from login). RentMy: POST /package/{product_uid}/availability.

variants.description: Variant selection, as RentMy's variants query parameter.

tools.name: rentmy_list_locations
tools.title: List pickup locations
tools.description: List the store's pickup locations. RentMy: GET /locations/list.

tools.name: rentmy_get_cart
tools.title: Get cart
tools.description: Get the items and totals of one cart by its token. RentMy: GET /carts/{cart_token}.

cart_token.description: Cart token from add-to-cart or get-cart.

tools.name: rentmy_add_to_cart
tools.title: Add item to cart
tools.description: Add a product variant to a cart for the given dates. Leave token empty to start a new cart; the response carries the token. Does not check out. Needs the store location (from login). RentMy: POST /carts/add-to-cart.

rental_type.description: Rental type, as RentMy names it (the spec example is rent).

token.description: Existing cart token. Omit to start a new cart.

driving_license_required.description: Whether a driving licence is required for this item.

tools.name: rentmy_update_cart_item
tools.title: Change cart item quantity
tools.description: Change the quantity of one cart item by a step (for example 1 or -1). RentMy: POST /carts/update.

token.description: Cart token from add-to-cart or get-cart.

id.description: Cart ID (the id field of the cart).

increment.description: Quantity change, positive or negative (RentMy's increment field).

tools.name: rentmy_remove_cart_item
tools.title: Remove cart item
tools.description: Remove one item from a cart. RentMy: POST /carts/cart-remove-item.

token.description: Cart token from add-to-cart or get-cart.

tools.name: rentmy_apply_coupon
tools.title: Apply coupon
tools.description: Apply a discount coupon to a cart. The spec also lists product_id and cart_item_id for this route; they are sent when given. RentMy: POST /carts/apply-coupon.

token.description: Cart token from add-to-cart or get-cart.

cart_item_id.description: Cart item ID, when RentMy needs it for the coupon.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with RentMy
prompts.description: What you can do with RentMy here, with example requests to try.
